text:
raj: Heads-up: planning a tf apply during the Sunday change window (03/29 02:00 UTC). Target release tag v2.14.0. Need provider pin and rollback playbook. Steps below.
alex: Pinged CI and staging - plans look clean. We should pin aws provider to 3.78.0 in modules before apply.
maria: Are we doing canary? I'd prefer a 5% traffic shift for peering updates.
sam: Agree on canary. Also adding a manual KMS key rebind step if grant changes.
raj: Deploybot will run the merge queue at 01:45 UTC. I'll create a manual hold until ops sign-off.
deploybot: [deploybot] queued: merge-lane/v2.14.0 -> plan started. CI: success. Approvals: 2/2.
raj: Preflight checklist:
- lock tfstate read-only from 01:50 to 02:30 UTC
- provider pin -> terraform required_providers block -> aws = 3.78.0
- run plan with env TF_VAR_region=us-west-2
- backup route table snapshots
- notify NOC
sam: I'll handle state lock and snapshots.
alex: Plan snippet:
```
terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars -lock-timeout=10m
# Expect change: aws_route.peer: replaces
```
maria: If the plan shows route replacement, we abort and roll to fallback tag v2.13.9 and open incident.
raj: Rollback playbook (short):
1) revert to release tag v2.13.9 (git revert merge commit)
2) run terraform apply with -target=aws_route.peer.safety -auto-approve
3) restore route table from snapshot if needed
4) escalate to oncall if >15m degradation
ops-oncall: I'll be online for the window and ready to cut the revert.
raj: Last thing: document the version pin in the release notes and add a note about manual KMS step.
alex: :thumbsup: sounds good. I'll draft release note and attach to PR.
maria: +1. set me as approver for the canary shift.
deploybot: [deploybot] apply scheduled for 02:00 UTC. Will pause for manual confirmation at 02:05 UTC before canary traffic shift.
raj: thanks team. tagging incident channel when we start: #inc-apply-v2-14-0
